reserveReview.reviewer: OpenAI Codex backing review; Kimi T24 re-verification
reserveReview.rationale: Ripio's current local-stablecoin page identifies WCLP as a Chilean-peso stablecoin in its wFIAT product family. Re-checked 2026-08-08: the wFIAT attestation index publishes CPA certifications for wARS (December 2025 and March 2026), wBRL, wCOP, and wMXN as of 2026-03-31, but still no wCLP attestation or reserve report, so the composition stays unclassified rather than borrowing sibling-token assurance. The repository's existing collateral description supports a single aggregate reserve envelope of Chilean-peso cash and liquid local-currency instruments, but the reviewed issuer page does not publish a WCLP-specific asset split, named financial institution, or reserve attestation.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Ripio wFIAT local-stablecoin disclosure for WCLP
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The full 100% reserve envelope remains unclassified beyond Chilean-peso cash and liquid local-currency instruments; no per-token attestation or current category weights were found.
